equation_summary: Same two-stage slot-summary architecture as ABC but with an explicitly supplied per-slot log-decay g (the layer computes f = logsigmoid(f_proj(x))/gate_logit_normalizer, then s = 1 - exp(f), and passes g=f). Stage 1: hk_t = hk_{t-1}*exp(g_t)[None,:] + k_t ⊗ s_t; ok_t = (scale*q_t)ᵀ hk_t; interstage qv_t = softmax(ok_t) (external). Stage 2: hv_t = hv_{t-1}*exp(g_t)[:,None] + s_t ⊗ v_t; o_t = qv_tᵀ hv_t. Both stages are additive (c=0) per-slot-decayed accumulations with after-update read; gates are data-dependent channel-scope and are NOT derived from cumulative softmax inside the op (unlike ABC's g=None path).
state_shape: two matrices per head: hk [K,M] (key x slot) and hv [M,V] (slot x value)
gate_scope: channel (per-slot) data-dependent log-decay g supplied externally (logsigmoid/normalizer provenance); identical gate in both stages
normalization: external interstage softmax over slots; stage-1 write gates s = 1-exp(g) (bounded complement of decay); no denominator state
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM call graph E[QKV/slot gates] ; B[K2 stage-1] ; E[slot softmax] ; B[K2 stage-2] ; E[output] matches naive_recurrent_gsa (naive.py:47-67) and the layer's g/s production (layers/gsa.py:186-198).

CONFIRM ledger blocker 'compare ABC/GSA state and gate semantics before any shared descriptor': verified — ABC (g=None path) derives g from logcumsumexp(s) and renormalizes s to cumulative softmax, whereas GSA receives g externally and sets s=1-exp(g); the transition algebra is identical but gate provenance and write-gate semantics differ, so a shared descriptor must parameterize gate provenance.
CORRECT (refinement, same as ABC): both stages are additive U2.A-with-channel-decay, not the canonical delta law U2.D — no retrieval correction term appears in either stage.
CONFIRM GQA-style num_kv_groups repetition of k,v,s,g across query groups (naive.py:31) is an external head-map concern.
direction_justification: GSA is the same family-generic two-call composition as ABC (two additive channel-decayed K2 calls joined by an external interstage softmax over the first call's output); the distinct gate provenance is an external operand, so admission is as a typed cross-call graph structure, not a new core mixer or axis.
